This page lists 68 Adobe Photoshop keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `photoshop.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Photoshop to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t photoshop.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/photoshop.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Photoshop 2024/Adobe Photoshop 2024.app`; if Adobe Photoshop lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## File Handling

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New blank file |
| `⌘O` | Open file |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌘W` | Close file |
| `⇧⌘W` | Close and open Bridge |

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘0` | Fit image on screen |
| `⌘+` | Zoom in |
| `⌘-` | Zoom out |
| `⌘H` | View/Hide extras |
| `Space+drag` | Drag image with Hand Tool |
| `F` | Toggle screen modes forward |
| `⇧F` | Toggle screen modes reverse |

## Image Adjustments

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘L` | Levels |
| `⌘M` | Curves |
| `⌘U` | Hue/Saturation |
| `⌘B` | Color Balance |
| `⌘I` | Invert |
| `⏎` | Accept adjustment |
| `⎋` | Cancel adjustment |

## Layers

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘N` | New Layer with options |
| `⌘G` | Group layers |
| `⇧⌘G` | Ungroup layers |
| `⌘E` | Merge selected layer down |
| `⌥⌘G` | Create/Remove Clipping Mask |
| `⌘I` | Invert Layer Mask |
| `⌘J` | New Layer via Copy |
| `⇧⌘J` | New Layer via Cut |
| `⌘T` | Transform layer |
| `⏎` | Accept Transformation |
| `⎋` | Cancel Transformation |

## Selections

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘A` | Select All |
| `⌘D` | Deselect |
| `⇧⌘D` | Reselect |
| `⇧⌘I` | Select Inverse |
| `⇧⌘A` | Select All Layers |
| `⇧+drag` | Constrain to square/circle |
| `⌥+drag` | Draw from center |
| `⇧⌥+drag` | Constrain and draw from center |
| `⇧+click` | Add to selection |
| `⌥+draw` | Remove from selection |
| `↑↓←→` | Nudge selection by pixels |

## Brushes

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧+click` | Constrain to straight line |
| `]` | Increase Brush Size |
| `[` | Decrease Brush Size |
| `1-0` | Brush Opacity (1=10%, 0=100%) |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |

## Tools

Press key to activate tool.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `V` | Move Tool |
| `M` | Marquee Tool |
| `L` | Lasso Tool |
| `W` | Quick Selection Tool |
| `C` | Crop and Slice Tool |
| `I` | Eyedropper/Sampler/Ruler Tool |
| `J` | Healing Brush Tool |
| `B` | Brush Tool |
| `S` | Clone Stamp Tool |
| `Y` | History Brush Tool |
| `E` | Eraser Tool |
| `G` | Gradient/Fill Tool |
| `O` | Dodge/Burn Tool |
| `P` | Pen Tool |
| `T` | Text Tool |
| `A` | Path Selection Tool |
| `U` | Shapes Tool |
| `H` | Hand Tool |
| `R` | Rotate Tool |
| `D` | Default colors (black/white) |
| `X` | Swap foreground/background colors |

## Template file

The full [`photoshop.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/photoshop.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
